sn54.2:1.1: ānāpānassati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.2:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānassati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.2:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ānāpānassatisahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn54.2:1.4: ānāpānassatisahagataṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ. viriya pīti passaddhi samādhi
sn54.2:1.5: ānāpānassatisahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn54.2:1.6: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānassati evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti.
